newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $13 bln of 52-wk bills July 17.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $13 bln of 52-wk bills July 17.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury said it will auction $13 billion of 52-week bills on July 17 to pay down $1.5 billion as $14.49 billion of 52-week bills are maturing.
The bills will be issued July 24 and mature July 23, 1998.
The CUSIP number for the bills will be 9127944X9.
Amounts issued to Federal Reserve banks for their own accounts will be shown as additions to the offering amount.
Treasury said Fed banks hold for their own accounts $5.695 billion of the 52-week issue that matures July 24.
